description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Issuance of Certificates of Exemption to Global Transportation and Logistics (Private) Limited, RIL Property (Private) Limited and Urban Investment & Development Company (Private) Limited
categorisation: This gazette notice involves the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing certificates of exemption from licensing requirements under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (Amended). This constitutes a regulatory action where a statutory body is exercising powers granted by legislation to create exemptions from regulatory requirements, which falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) rather than government personnel/structure categories.
